title: Membership in the true-coordinate index set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $j$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $i$ index a Boolean string of length $n$. Then $i$ belongs to the set of indices whose string has value true at coordinate $j$ if and only if the string indexed by $i$ has value true at coordinate $j$.
